node.title: Workspace Feature Canvas
node.summary: Interactive canvas for exploring a repository as a feature hierarchy, with selection, hierarchy layout, zoom controls, and feature inspection.

node.title: Feature Map Visualization
node.summary: Shows mapped product features as connected nodes in a hierarchical canvas with automatic layout and status badges.

node.title: Feature Details Inspector
node.summary: Displays the selected feature's summary, health, implementation files, missing files, evidence summary, risks, and actions.

node.title: Canvas Navigation Controls
node.summary: Supports panning, zooming, background grid, and on-screen controls for navigating large feature maps.

node.title: Codex Build Requests
node.summary: Lets the user ask Codex to build or change the selected repository and applies returned graph updates to the canvas.

node.title: Prompt Composer with Feature Mentions
node.summary: Rich prompt editor supports @mentioning mapped features, inserting them from the canvas, and keeping referenced feature IDs with the request.

node.title: Codex Model and Effort Selection
node.summary: Users can choose which Codex model and reasoning effort to run for a request.

node.title: Run Status Tracking
node.summary: Shows whether Codex is idle, working, testing, completed, or failed, with phase, message, elapsed time, and action slots.

node.title: Codex App Server Execution
node.summary: Starts a Codex app-server session, streams JSON-RPC notifications, tracks turn lifecycle, and converts run activity into graph updates.

node.title: Feature-Scoped Requests
node.summary: Build requests can be focused on one or more referenced features by expanding the prompt with feature context, risks, evidence, and related files.

node.title: Repository Mapping and Sync
node.summary: Loads a project, scans its files, imports a feature hierarchy, persists graph events, and refreshes the canvas from the current repository state.

node.title: Repository Selection
node.summary: Users can choose a local repository, with native folder selection on macOS and saved repo path reuse in local storage.

node.title: Repository Import
node.summary: Scans repository artifacts and converts them into a product-oriented feature hierarchy using an OpenAI observer or heuristic fallback.

node.title: Saved Project Map Loading
node.summary: Loads previously saved graph events for the current repository and reconstructs the feature timeline and current graph state.

node.title: Project Rescan
node.summary: Refreshes the repository map by rescanning the current repo snapshot and replacing persisted graph events.

node.title: Graph Event Persistence
node.summary: Stores imported graph events and Codex run graph events in a repository-local .cocanvas history for later reloads.

node.title: Missing File Sanitization
node.summary: Filters related files against the current repository, removes missing references from returned nodes, and reports missing paths by feature.

node.title: Demo Replay Mode
node.summary: Provides a mock project replay that animates example graph events and lets the user return to the real project map afterward.

node.title: Animated Event Replay
node.summary: Replays imported demo events in timed batches so the feature map appears to build itself step by step.

node.title: Return to Project Map
node.summary: Allows switching back from the demo replay to the current repository's saved or freshly imported project map.

node.title: Graph Event Engine
node.summary: Reduces append-only graph events into the current canvas state, selection state, hierarchy edges, and timeline items.

node.title: Interactive Feature Selection
node.summary: Supports selecting and clearing the active feature from the canvas and keeping selection synchronized with the current reduced graph.

node.title: Feature Timeline Feed
node.summary: Builds a chronological timeline of graph updates that can be returned by APIs alongside the current graph.

node.title: AI Observation and Inference
node.summary: Uses OpenAI-backed observers to translate repository snapshots and Codex run activity into cocanvas feature graph events, with fallback heuristics when needed.

node.title: Repository Snapshot Interpretation
node.summary: Interprets scanned repository artifacts as product areas and feature hierarchies for the canvas.

node.title: Codex Run Interpretation
node.summary: Interprets Codex app-server raw events and assistant output into product-facing graph changes for the canvas.

node.title: Heuristic Import Fallback
node.summary: Builds an initial feature hierarchy from file names, routes, and artifact kinds when LLM-based import is unavailable.

node.title: Application Shell and Branding
node.summary: Provides the main Next.js shell, global typography, styling, and product identity for cocanvas.

node.title: Global Visual Style
node.summary: Defines the overall visual theme, typography, animations, and shared canvas UI styling.
